overall_assessment: LCC is operationally distinct as a kill-test discipline, but not yet theoretically distinct from model-based causal control families.

theories.name: model_based_rl
theories.lcc_distinction: label/effect split, intervention-grounded effect evidence, behavior-only replay, anti-shortcut scans
theories.needed_test: strong learned-dynamics planner under blind holdout and label/effect swaps

theories.name: causal_model_based_control
theories.lcc_distinction: selector-level action-distribution causality and provenance audit
theories.needed_test: causal graph learner plus planner with no oracle graph or role schema

theories.name: active_inference
theories.overlap: generative model control and uncertainty reduction
theories.lcc_distinction: explicit effect perturbation and label-invariance gates
theories.needed_test: strong expected-free-energy implementation under the same observation restrictions

theories.name: empowerment
theories.lcc_distinction: rejects action-label future-option proxy and requires goal-conditioned model reuse
theories.needed_test: learned empowerment/information-gain planner against blind holdout and negative controls

theories.name: predictive_processing
theories.lcc_distinction: requires intervention-grounded action selection, not report-level prediction quality
theories.needed_test: predictive-control implementation with counterfactual action-distribution perturbations
